title: pm-dispatch: state that `Unlock-action:` admits only its canonical value
body:
Closes #12449

## The ruling

Maintainer, 2026-08-26, verbatim and untranslated: 「**这个应该更新skill吧**」 — accepting the
card's **option B**: state the rule in the instruction text. ⛔ Option A (closed enumeration +
patrol rejection) is **not** taken: no new predicate, no reader-side change, no new vocabulary,
no enumeration list to maintain. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is untouched.

## What the text now says

`Unlock-action:` is a two-valued switch on the unlock scan's exit path, but nothing said so and
nothing rejects a sentence written after the colon. A prose `Unlock-action:` line neither fires
nor errors — the card silently takes the DEFAULT exit (re-dispatch), which for a finished-work
card is exactly the ⛔ the slot exists to prevent. Measured on the live board and recorded on the
card: the slot is used by exactly 1 of 68 open `pm:blocked` cards in this repo, and that one
instance is prose; the PM's own earlier use was prose too and only "worked" because a human
returned to execute it by hand.

Both mentions now name the canonical literal and mark it as the only value read:

- `references/state-machine.md` (the slot's spec home) — the `pm:blocked` bullet now reads
  `` `Unlock-action: re-check PR #M` ``(**只认此一值**,别的静默回落重派,散文另起行). The
  prose-on-its-own-line half deliberately echoes the `Blocked-by:` rule stated two lines above in
  the same section (指令是行,提及是散文), so the reader sees one rule and not two.
- `SKILL.md` state table — the `pm:blocked` row spelled the slot as `` `Unlock-action:` 行改写解锁动作 ``,
  which is itself the invitation the card diagnosed ("the slot *looks* like a place to write what
  to do, because that is what its name says"). It now carries the canonical literal plus
  **只认此一值**,别的写法静默回落默认重派, and keeps its pointer at the reference file.

## Paid in place — no ceiling raised, nothing thinned

Both ceilings are unchanged, and the ratchet's own verdict lines at the final commit (`80694fa02`)
confirm it:

```
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md is 44 lines (ceiling 44; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 1004 lines (ceiling 1005; headroom 1).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md: widest table row is 765 bytes (pin 765; headroom 0).
```

`state-machine.md` had **zero** headroom and every bullet already at its minimum line count under
the 120-byte cap, so the added clause was paid by compressing the same bullet, byte for byte:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| bullet bytes (3 lines, cap 360 incl. 2 continuation indents) | 337 | 357 |
| file lines | 44 | 44 |

The 20 net bytes came from four content-preserving compressions inside that bullet, each checked
against the fact it carries:

- `` `Blocked-by:` 指向门禁缺陷卡 `` → `指向门禁卡` — the short form the bullet's own last clause
  already uses. (An earlier draft read `指向该卡`; PM review caught that `该卡`'s nearest antecedent
  is the blocked card at the head of the same sentence, so it read as `Blocked-by:` pointing at
  itself. Corrected in `a46a3872a`, paid in the same bullet by `的卡同用本态` → `者同用本态`.)
- `正文另加机器可读行` → `正文加机器可读行`.
- `的卡同用本态` → `者同用本态`.
- `解锁扫描把解锁动作从「回队重派」换成「重查该 PR 落地」` → `解锁扫描改出口为「重查该 PR 落地」` —
  the default exit's name (重派) did not disappear; it moved into the new clause, where it is now
  stated as the thing a non-canonical spelling falls back to.

Every other clause of the bullet survives verbatim: 同用本态 · ⛔ 不设新标签 · ⛔ 永不给完工卡重派 dev ·
停放 PR 正文须点名门禁卡. `SKILL.md`'s edit is inside an existing table row (281 → 360 bytes), so it
costs no line and leaves the widest-row pin (765) untouched.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against the
real change set, and re-derived at the final commit (same nine families). Exit codes
captured before any pipe; verdict lines are each gate's own. The table below is the union run at `80694fa02`; after the PM-review
correction in `a46a3872a` the ratchet and id-lint were re-run at that head and both stayed green — `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: ... state-machine.md is 44 lines (ceiling 44; headroom 0).`, `✓ ... SKILL.md is 1004 lines (ceiling 1005; headroom 1).`, `✓ ... SKILL.md: widest table row is 765 bytes (pin 765; headroom 0).`, `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 22 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).`

| gate | verdict at `80694fa02` |
|---|---|
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | ✓ both edited files at their unchanged ceilings (quoted above) |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 22 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).` — no issue numbers written into either file |
| `check:pm-governed-prose` | `✓ check-governed-prose: 2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces … and claim no others.` |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 159 assertions …` |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files` |
| `check:doc-authoring` | `✓ doc authoring guard: 390 files clean — no bare metadata literals.` · `✓ doc authoring guard: 48 published skill files clean — no internal issue-id references.` |
| `check:agent-test-spelling` | `✓ check-agent-test-spelling: 0 violations — 386 file(s) …` |
| `check:doc-formula-expressions` | exit 0 (needed `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint` built first — its own preflight said so, and nothing was measured until they were) |
| `check-governed-queue-guard` | not locally runnable — it reads `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` and refuses to exit 0 without a workflow event payload. CI runs it. |

No changeset: `.claude/**` only, nothing published — `skip-changeset`.
